1 | PASS | `src/app/signup/page.tsx` implements user registration via Supabase Auth `signUp`.
2 | PASS | `src/app/login/page.tsx` implements user login via Supabase Auth `signInWithPassword`.
3 | PASS | `src/components/Navbar.tsx` implements logout via `supabase.auth.signOut`.
4 | PASS | `supabase_schema.sql` defines durable tables for users, listings, bookings, and payments.
5 | PASS | `src/app/page.tsx` and `ListingGrid.tsx` display listings in a structured grid.
6 | FAIL | Search filters location and type, but missing date and price filters in UI and logic.
7 | PASS | `src/app/listings/[id]/page.tsx` displays detailed property info and description.
8 | PASS | `src/components/BookingForm.tsx` has date pickers, guest select, and price calculation.
9 | PASS | `src/lib/actions.ts` `createBooking` inserts booking data into the database.
10 | PASS | `src/app/listings/new/page.tsx` allows posting new rental properties.
11 | FAIL | Dashboard has delete link but no edit page (`/listings/[id]/edit`) or archive logic implemented.
12 | PASS | `src/app/dashboard/page.tsx` displays trip history and hosting activity.
13 | FAIL | No real-time updates or concurrency checks (e.g., RLS triggers) to prevent double-booking.
14 | PASS | Database schema and server actions ensure durable persistence of bookings and metadata.
15 | PASS | `src/lib/stripe.ts` and `route.ts` integrate Stripe for end-to-end payments.
16 | PASS | `createStripeCheckout` in `actions.ts` captures details and redirects to Stripe for charging.
17 | PASS | `payments` table stores status; webhook updates status to succeeded/failed.
18 | PASS | `src/app/dashboard/page.tsx` displays booking status and total cost to users.
19 | FAIL | No UI for retrying failed payments or switching methods; only basic error display.
20 | PASS | `src/app/listings/new/page.tsx` allows uploading multiple photos via file input.
21 | PASS | `src/app/listings/new/page.tsx` accepts video files and stores them in media table.
22 | FAIL | No UI controls for reordering or removing uploaded photos/videos in create/edit flow.
23 | PASS | `src/components/ImageGallery.tsx` displays photos in a grid/carousel layout.
24 | PASS | `src/components/ImageGallery.tsx` displays videos using an embedded `<video>` player.

rubric.4: Application stores all users, listings, bookings, and associated metadata in a durable database.
rubric.5: Application allows users to browse available properties in a structured, visually clear interface.
rubric.6: Application provides property search with filters for location, dates, price, and property type.
rubric.7: Application displays detailed property pages that include descriptions and essential listing information.
rubric.8: Application implements a booking flow that includes a date picker, guest count selection, and accurate price calculation.
rubric.9: Application allows users to book a property and ensures all booking data is stored in the database.
rubric.10: Application allows users to post new rental properties for others to book.
rubric.11: Application provides full listing management, including the ability to edit, archive, and delete properties.
rubric.12: Application provides each user with a dashboard that displays their trip history and their hosting activity.
rubric.13: Application delivers real-time availability updates to ensure that no property can be double-booked.
rubric.14: Application persists all bookings and listing metadata in the database in a durable and consistent manner.
rubric.15: Application integrates with a secure modern payment provider to process end-to-end payments.
rubric.16: Application captures payment details during the booking flow and charges the guest upon booking confirmation or according to the selected payment model.
rubric.17: Application records all payment transactions in the database with statuses such as pending, succeeded, failed, or refunded.
rubric.18: Application provides user-facing views that display payment-related information such as total cost and payment status.
rubric.19: Application handles payment errors gracefully by surfacing clear messages and allowing users to retry or switch payment methods.
rubric.20: Application allows hosts to upload multiple photos for each listing as part of the creation and editing flow.
rubric.21: Application allows hosts to upload at least one video for each listing.
rubric.22: Application provides clear UI controls for adding, previewing, reordering, and removing uploaded photos and videos.
rubric.23: Application displays uploaded photos prominently on the property detail page using a gallery or carousel.
rubric.24: Application displays uploaded videos prominently on the property detail page using an embedded video player.
